title: Sinapic acid and glabridin synergistically mitigate androgenetic alopecia by modulating ferroptosis through stabilization of beta-catenin against ubiquitin-dependent degradation.
authors: Huang, Zhiguang; Weng, Zhiwei; Yuan, Jianchang; Liu, Yanlin; Fu, Hangjie; Xie, Yixin; Li, Yuanyuan; Feng, Sihan; Mao, Qingqing; Luo, Kaitao; Ding, Bin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物通过稳定β-catenin缓解雄激素性脱发中的铁死亡，核心是细胞信号通路与湿实验，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Androgenetic alopecia (AGA), commonly known as male pattern hair loss, with limited effective treatments. Sinapic acid (S) and glabridin (G) are two ingredients in Zhimo herbal extract (ZMHE), identified with UPLC-Q/TOF-MS. We comparatively investigated the effects and mechanisms of S and G, individually and synergistically (S&G), on dihydrotestosterone (DHT)-induced AGA model mice and in dermal papilla cells (DPCs). In our work, S&G showed superior effect on DHT induced oxidative stress in DPCs and on hair growth in AGA mice, compared to application of these two compounds individually. Additionally, S&G significantly reversed the DHT induced abnormal high level of ferrous ions and 4-HNE, overexpressed ACSL4 and FTH1, and morphological variation of mitochondria in mice and in DPCs, as well as lipid peroxidation in DPCs assays. These results suggested that S&G has beneficial effect on DHT induced ferroptosis. To uncover the mechanism, we found that S&G could significantly improve the content of beta-Catenin in DHT treated DPCs by inhibiting the phosphorylation induced ubiquitin-dependent degradation. The result of molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay tests indicated that S&G enhanced the stability of beta-Catenin by binding at Ser191 and Glu163/Gln165/Thr201. And the translocated beta-Catenin/Tcf-4 triggered expression of GPX4 in DHT treated DPCs and murine skins, which ameliorated the DHT induced peroxidation and reversed the harmful effect of DHT on hair growth. This study suggested that S&G could be applied for AGA treatment, which could attenuate DHT induced ferroptosis by improving the ubiquitin-dependent degradation of beta-Catenin.
abstract_zh: 雄激素性脱发（androgenetic alopecia, AGA），俗称男性型脱发，有效治疗方法有限。芥子酸（sinapic acid, S）和光甘草定（glabridin, G）是知母提取物（Zhimo herbal extract, ZMHE）中的两种成分，通过UPLC-Q/TOF-MS鉴定。我们比较研究了S和G单独及协同（S&G）对双氢睾酮（dihydrotestosterone, DHT）诱导的AGA模型小鼠及真皮乳头细胞（dermal papilla cells, DPCs）的作用和机制。在我们的工作中，与单独使用这两种化合物相比，S&G在DHT诱导的DPCs氧化应激和AGA小鼠毛发生长方面表现出更优效果。此外，S&G显著逆转了DHT诱导的小鼠和DPCs中亚铁离子及4-HNE异常升高、ACSL4和FTH1过表达、线粒体形态变化，以及DPCs测定中的脂质过氧化。这些结果表明，S&G对DHT诱导的铁死亡（ferroptosis）具有有益作用。为揭示其机制，我们发现S&G可通过抑制磷酸化诱导的泛素依赖性降解，显著提高DHT处理的DPCs中β-Catenin的含量。分子对接和细胞热位移分析（cellular thermal shift assay）结果表明，S&G通过结合Ser191和Glu163/Gln165/Thr201增强β-Catenin的稳定性。转位的β-Catenin/Tcf-4在DHT处理的DPCs和小鼠皮肤中触发GPX4表达，从而改善DHT诱导的过氧化并逆转DHT对毛发生长的有害影响。本研究提示，S&G可用于AGA治疗，通过改善β-Catenin的泛素依赖性降解来减轻DHT诱导的铁死亡。
